control_boundary: Each sqlx case owns one marked disposable database. Tampering is deliberately after a successful replay, inside a separate rollback-only transaction; it calibrates the same full-row guard without bypassing the immutable file digest. These controls do not simulate every possible replay statement omission or PostgreSQL fault.
error_calibration: Each DML must succeed and affect exactly one row before reading the altered state. Each expected panic must have the exact digest/full-row message; unrelated storage or decoding failures are test failures. No sensitive fixture values enter assertion diagnostics.

pre_mortem: A vacuous negative control could pass on storage failure or a different panic. Positive seed, exact one-row DML success, same shared guard with exact panic message, and explicit rollback+full/material readback distinguish real rejection.
blast_radius: Only separate private candidate/patch/guide files written; no repository, original proposal, Cargo, service or DB mutation by author. Future controls touch only their SQLx-owned disposable DB.
rollback: Every DB mutation is inside an explicitly rolled-back transaction; a failed assertion drops the transaction and fails the owned disposable test. Root harness retains cleanup/absence custody.
